title: Program Services Included by Tier, Insurer Program Agreements
content:
Which services the network performs or holds for an insurer under the Insurer Program Agreements is fixed by tier in four yes-or-no terms:

- **Desk review** — whether network appraisers review estimates on the insurer's behalf.
- **Total-loss handling** — whether the network handles total-loss vehicle release to salvage for the insurer.
- **Glass program** — whether the insurer's glass claims are routed to the network's glass service.
- **Quarterly business review** — whether a quarterly business review meeting is held with the insurer.

| Agreement tier | Desk review by network appraisers | Total-loss release to salvage by network | Glass claims routed to network glass service | Quarterly business review |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network Referral Agreement | No | No | No | No |
| Select Direct Repair Agreement | No | No | No | No |
| Preferred Direct Repair Agreement | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Premier Direct Repair Agreement | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Managed Repair Program Agreement | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Enterprise Master Services Agreement | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the matrix by service

- Desk review on the insurer's behalf: Managed Repair Program Agreement and Enterprise Master Services Agreement only.
- Total-loss release to salvage: Premier Direct Repair Agreement and the two tiers above it.
- Glass claims to the network's glass service, and the quarterly business review: Preferred Direct Repair Agreement and every tier above it.
- Network Referral Agreement and Select Direct Repair Agreement include none of the four.

## Questions on scope

**Are an insurer's glass claims routed to the network's glass service under a Select Direct Repair Agreement?** No; the glass program term reads "No" for that tier.

**Does the network release a total-loss vehicle to salvage for an insurer on a Preferred Direct Repair Agreement?** No; total-loss handling reads "Yes" from the Premier Direct Repair Agreement upward.
